messages:
Aisha (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Aerodyne Labs onboarding. They signed for Redwood Private (VPC) and want a 45-day path to pilot. Main asks: SSO/SCIM, EU data residency, and an on-prem gateway evaluation. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and immediate risks.

Tom (Solutions): Quick q — who’s the Aerodyne PM on their side? also do we have a preferred lead for model/serving guidance?

Priya (Customer PM): Aerodyne PM is Alice K. (CTO). Internal stakeholders: Alice (CTO), Ben R. (Infra), Dr. Chen (ML lead), Carlos (SSO admin). They want weekly checkpoints (Wed mornings) and a go/no-go vote at day 30.

Mateo (Onboarding Eng): Got it. My immediate checklist: 1) VPC peering rules, 2) SSO cert exchange, 3) staging workload runbook, 4) quantization profile for 16-bit fallback. Assigning owners below.

Jin (Security): Heads up — they mentioned EU residency + SOC2 plus internal pen-test requirement. If they require additional attestations we might push pilot beyond 45d. Also will need KMS / HSM onboarding window. Marking as potential renewal risk until attestations cleared.

Nora (Enablement): I'll run two enablement sessions: intro (platform + API) and ops (troubleshooting + cost controls). Polling preference: A) Wed 10am PT B) Thu 2pm PT. Which works for Aerodyne devs?

Aisha (CSM): Action items I’m capturing: 
- Owner: Mateo — network + staging (due day 7)
- Owner: Tom — model architecture guidance + perf targets (due day 10)
- Owner: Jin — compliance checklist & KMS plan (due day 12)
- Owner: Nora — enablement schedule + materials (due day 9)
- Owner: Priya — stakeholder confirmations + calendar invites (due day 3)
I’ll create the shared onboarding playbook and add a renewal_risk column. Link: https://docs.redwood.example/s/Aerodyne-onboard (please add notes).

Tom (Solutions): For perf targets, propose: 95th p50 token latency < 120ms for interactive endpoints, embeddings throughput >= 200 qps in dedicated pool emulation. Will test on staging after peering.

Mateo (Onboarding Eng): Network snippet for reference (will paste to doc):
```
# VPC peering minimal egress rules
allow: outbound 443 -> redwood-inference.eu
allow: outbound 10250 -> metrics.redwood.internal
# cert: want PEM bundle for SSO SAML from Aerodyne
```

Priya (Customer PM): Added Aerodyne SSO contact (carlos@aerodyne.com) to the doc. They prefer Wed 10am PT for the intro. I invited Alice + Ben + Chen.

Jin (Security): Noted. Also request: audit log retention scope — they need 13 months storage for compliance. Can Ops confirm retention tier options?

Aisha (CSM): Ops: @Tom, @Mateo — can you confirm log retention options here? if 13 months requires add-on, flag pricing impact so we can surface to customer.

Tom (Solutions): Confirmed — 13-month retention is available as an add-on. I'll draft cost delta and add to playbook.

Mateo (Onboarding Eng): I'll provision staging with default 90-day retention for now, can extend after sign-off.

Nora (Enablement): Scheduling: intro set for Wed 10am PT. Ops session for Thu 2pm PT (tentative). I'll upload slide deck + short runbook to the doc.

Priya (Customer PM): Quick risk note from Aerodyne: procurement requires signed DPA and SOC2 report before provisioning prod capacity. They requested draft DPA by next Tue.

Aisha (CSM): Jin — please coordinate with Legal/Trust to prioritize DPA & SOC2 extract. Treat as high priority risk for renewal if delayed.

Jin (Security): On it. Looping in Legal now. Also request Aerodyne share their pen-test window — we should avoid scheduling heavy load during that.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Create calendar event for "Aerodyne onboarding — intro" on 1865432400 (Wed 10:00 PT) with guests: Aisha, Priya, Nora, Alice K., Ben R., Dr. Chen.

Aisha (CSM): Summary / next steps in doc: https://docs.redwood.example/s/Aerodyne-onboard — please add estimated delivery dates inline. Meeting invites sent. I'll follow up with a 1:1 with Priya tomorrow.

Tom (Solutions): I'll post perf test plan to the doc by EOD.

Mateo (Onboarding Eng): Will start VPC peering ticket after Priya confirms network CIDR.

Priya (Customer PM): CIDR confirmed in doc. Thanks all — this looks actionable.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks team :raised_hands: — marking this thread in our weekly cadence. If any blocker pops up tag #onboard-blockers.

Nora (Enablement): Uploaded slides + quickstart. LGTM.

Jin (Security): Legal pulled SOC2 excerpt, uploading to the doc. Potential renewal risk cleared if no surprises.

Priya (Customer PM): Aero legal signed DPA draft this morning. Closing loop on that item.

Aisha (CSM): Awesome — moving to weekly checkpoints. Closing today’s kickoff with owners assigned.

Tom (Solutions): 👍

Mateo (Onboarding Eng): Calendar invite accepted.

Priya (Customer PM): Thanks everyone, talk soon.

Nora (Enablement): Closing notes: record intro session and add to training library for future customers.
